name: Levofloxacin
mechanism: Inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV
dosing: CAP: 500mg OD-BD for 5-7 days. UTI: 500mg OD for 7-10 days. IV/PO
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to quinolones, epilepsy, QT prolongation, tendon disorders
interactions: NSAIDs (seizure risk), corticosteroids (tendon rupture), drugs prolonging QT
monitoring: Tendon pain, CNS effects, blood glucose (diabetes), ECG if QT risk
pregnancy: Avoid - cartilage damage in animal studies
sideEffects: Nausea, diarrhoea, tendon rupture, QT prolongation, photosensitivity, C. diff
clinicalPearls: Reserve for resistant infections. Warn about tendon rupture risk. Sun protection advised
indication: Community-acquired pneumonia, complicated UTI, chronic prostatitis, anthrax (as per guidelines)
